commit 899538bfb6fcef42dd3b446890f725e2afe366f5
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Fri Mar 7 09:12:35 2025 +0200
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Fri Mar 7 09:12:35 2025 +0200

    Bug 1931277 - c-c part of using only interesting probes. r=tobyp
    
    Only collect probes we have an interest in. The files I've is IMHO roughtly it. If we really want we can have specific files where we copy in only specific metrics - but the whole metric definition needs to be included (due to json schema validation).
    The probes we do not care about are still enabled during tests, by applying interesting_serverknobs.json during automation runs, so that tests succeed. This work was enabled in bug 1942797.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D228972

diff --git a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
index b9c2caea95c..75d911a7c9c 100644
--- a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
+++ b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
@@ -487,3 +487,7 @@
 
 ; Shutdown Terminator
 @RESPATH@/components/terminator.manifest
+
+; Shipped so that Glean tests are enabled on CI even if we have disabled
+; them during regular usage.
+@RESPATH@/interesting_serverknobs.json
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 0d2bfde4efe..6b96b582c1a 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -95,6 +95,38 @@ set_config(
 )
 # set_config("MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_PINGS_FILES", ["comm/mail/pings.yaml"])
 set_config("MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_TAGS_FILES", ["comm/mail/tags.yaml"])
+set_config(
+    "MOZ_GLEAN_INTERESTING_METRICS_FILES",
+    [
+        "comm/mail/metrics.yaml",
+        "comm/mail/components/addrbook/metrics.yaml",
+        "comm/mail/components/cloudfile/metrics.yaml",
+        "comm/mail/components/compose/metrics.yaml",
+        "comm/mail/components/inappnotifications/metrics.yaml",
+        "comm/calendar/metrics.yaml",
+        "modules/libpref/metrics.yaml",
+        "parser/htmlparser/metrics.yaml",
+        # NOTE: test_pkcs11_module.js will fail without this.
+        # The pkcs11 runs before serverknobs can be applied.
+        "security/manager/ssl/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/content/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/components/crashes/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/components/pdfjs/metrics.yaml",
+        # Could be useful, but fails "Sorry, Glean found some glinter nits".
+        # "toolkit/components/startup/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/mozapps/defaultagent/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/mozapps/extensions/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/mozapps/update/metrics.yaml",
+        # NOTE: BackgroundTask_shouldprocessupdates.sys.mjs will fail without this
+        # It doesn't consider itself to be in automation, and is also
+        # collecting metrics too early, in XRE_mainStartup.
+        "toolkit/mozapps/update/shared_metrics.yaml",
+        # Could be useful, but fails "Sorry, Glean found some glinter nits".
+        # "toolkit/profile/metrics.yaml",
+        "toolkit/xre/metrics.yaml",
+    ],
+)
+
 
 include("../build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure")
